population: worker_type='Employee'; employee_type='Regular'; active_status=1 at the 2026-08-23 monthly snapshot
grain: Direct-manager team at one monthly snapshot; manager is excluded from their own report group

definition.team_membership: Active regular direct reports sharing manager_employee_id in the cutoff snapshot; reg_non_intern_dir_reports > 0 corroborates the manager record.
definition.comparable_group: Within one direct-manager team, direct reports sharing country, compensation_grade, and FTE annual-base-pay currency.
definition.eligibility: At least two direct reports with nonblank country, compensation_grade, currency, and positive fte_annual_base_pay. Missing inputs and singleton groups do not form a comparable group.
definition.pay_spread: max(fte_annual_base_pay) / min(fte_annual_base_pay) - 1, calculated only inside an eligible comparable group.
definition.flag_rule: A comparable group is flagged when its FTE-adjusted base-pay spread is at least 10%.
definition.manager_metrics: For each manager with one or more eligible groups: flagged-group count and flagged-group share of eligible comparable groups. Managers with no eligible group are kept in a separate No comparable groups state, not assigned zero.

membership_integrity.acceptance_rule: No active-regular or active-manager snapshot duplicate keys; every assigned direct-report manager resolves uniquely and has reg_non_intern_dir_reports > 0.

reconciliation.acceptance_rule: Comparable-manager count and No comparable groups state reconcile to the direct-manager universe; both count and rate distributions reconcile to comparable managers; flagged groups do not exceed eligible groups.

privacy.acceptance_rule: Presentation evidence stores aggregate manager counts only; all displayed buckets meet n >= 30 and omit identifiers, country/grade/currency labels, and pay values.

limitation: This is a descriptive review signal, not a pay-equity finding. It does not model tenure, performance, job profile, labor-market differences within a country, or other legitimate compensation factors. The stored FTE annual-base-pay field is used as an operational normalization and does not establish authoritative compensation lineage.
